Package neqsim.process.equipment.reactor.sulfurrecovery

Class AirDemandController

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.reactor.sulfurrecovery.AirDemandController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class AirDemandController extends Object implements Serializable
Feed-forward and tail-gas feedback calculation for Claus combustion-air demand.

The feed-forward term burns one third of the H2S and completely oxidizes configured ammonia and hydrocarbon contaminants. The feedback term trims that demand from the measured tail-gas H2S/SO2 ratio. A flowsheet may use calculateOxygenDemand(SystemInterface) alone or use calculateTrimmedOxygenDemand(SystemInterface, double) in an outer convergence loop.
